title: Somnath – Dwarka
subtitle: Dwarkadish Temple · Somnath Jyotirlinga · Girnar Darshan · Bet Dwarka

travel.arrival: Reach Mumbai by 06:00 AM, 21 Jan 2026 (Saurashtra Janta Express 19218 from Junagadh)

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Mumbai Central Railway Station. Reporting Time: 8:00 PM, 15 January 2026. Train: Saurashtra Mail. Board train for Dwarka. Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Dwarka Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Reach Dwarka Railway Station by approximately 1:15 PM. Proceed to hotel and check in. Lunch at own cost. Visit Dwarkadhish Temple and Rukmini Temple. Return to hotel, dinner and rest. Overnight at Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Bet Dwarka and Somnath
itinerary.description: Breakfast and hotel checkout. Visit Bet Dwarka and Nageshwar Temple. Lunch en route at own expense. Continue to Somnath (4.5 hrs). Evening visit to Somnath Jyotirlinga. Check in at hotel, dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Somnath to Girnar
itinerary.description: Breakfast and checkout. Visit Bhalka Teerth, Geeta Mandir, and Triveni Sangam. Travel towards Girnar (2.5 hrs). Reach Girnar, check in at hotel. Dinner and rest. Overnight at Girnar/Junagadh.

itinerary.title: Girnar Darshan
itinerary.description: Start early for Girnar Darshan. Breakfast en route at own expense. Reach Girnar Ropeway point and take ropeway to top. Complete Girnar Darshan. Ropeway tickets must be booked online at udankhatola.com (time slot: 7:00 AM - 8:00 AM). Return to hotel. Dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Junagadh to Mumbai
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Check out and proceed towards Junagadh Railway Station. Board return train (Saurashtra Janta Express, 19218) at approximately 12:58 PM. Overnight journey to Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai at approximately 6:00 AM. Return home with sweet memories!

advisory: Girnar ropedway tickets must be booked online at udankhatola.com. Time slot: 7 AM - 8 AM. Carry valid ID proof.
